fields.description: Low word of the 64-bit slot sequence counter; FUN_080039d4 compares the (lo,hi) pairs of both slots to select the newest valid image.

File offset 0x5FF0 = slot-0 base 0x5000 + 0xFF0; reads 0xFFFFFFFF (erased trailer) in samples/baseline.sav.

fields.description: Low word of the stored 64-bit additive checksum over image bytes [0, 0xFF8).

File offset 0x5FF8 = slot-0 base + 0xFF8; reads 0xFFFFFFFF (erased) in samples/baseline.sav, so no checksums entry is emitted.
